title: Food delivery order tracking: a producer whose retries break per-key ordering
name: Order status publisher

questions.prompt: Customer support is seeing tickets like "the app says my order was just accepted, but the food is already here". The pushes arrive scrambled too: "Your courier is on the way" comes before "The restaurant accepted your order". Each time, the status publisher logged a NOT_LEADER_FOR_PARTITION error during a broker leader election. Every event is eventually sent, and all of an order's events land on the same partition. Fix StatusPublisher so the tests pass.
